newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW sets Golf base price at 25,700 marks.
newsitem.headline: VW sets Golf base price at 25,700 marks.

text.p: German carmaker Volkswagen AG has set the price of its new Golf base model at 25,700 marks, cheaper than the current model, VW management board member Robert Buechelhofer told Reuters.
Buechelhofer said at the world premiere of the new Golf in Bonn that the price was about 400 marks cheaper than the current base model on an equivalent vehicle with a 75-horsepower engine.
"We thought that it was wise to move along with evolution and not a revolution. It is a totally new car. It is a new level of quality and sophistication in the Golf segment," he said.

VW had been expected to aggressively price the new Golf, the world's best-selling car with nearly 18 million so far produced since 1974, as it did last year in launching a new version of the Passat saloon.
